title: Bear cub waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <!-- belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#D4A26A'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='20' fill='#A0704A'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='28' r='8' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='28' r='8' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='28' r='4.5' fill='#D4A26A'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='28' r='4.5' fill='#D4A26A'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#E8C89A'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='3' fill='#2E1A0E'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='40' r='3' fill='#2E1A0E'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='39' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='39' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='49' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#2E1A0E'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 54 Q50 58 55 54' stroke='#2E1A0E' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left arm (down) -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='75' rx='7' ry='11' fill='#A0704A' transform='rotate(15 28 75)'/>
  <!-- right arm (waving up) -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='58' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#A0704A' transform='rotate(-30 74 58)'/>
  <!-- paw pad on waving hand -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='48' r='5' fill='#D4A26A'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='93' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='93' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='93' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#D4A26A'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='93' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#D4A26A'/>
</svg>
